questions.stem: A 47-year-old man has been chronically fatigued for the past year. A physical examination yields no abnormal findings. A CBC shows: Hgb 10.8 g/dL, MCV 102 fL, His serum vitamin B12 and folate levels are normal. Which of the following underlying conditions is most likely to explain his findings?
